description: Official registers of tokenized assets and digital-asset firms for 250 jurisdictions (ISO 3166 + EU): supervising authority, public registers, which of them are read, and their entries. Supports a country view, a name search across all registers (query without country) and a filter by kind (e.g. issuance). A register entry records a licence, registration or approval by an authority; it is not proof that a token was issued and does not state who may buy. Provider registers list companies, not instruments.

country.description: ISO code (DE, HK), English name or slug (germany, hong-kong). Omit to search every register.

kind.description: issuance = individual issues; issuer = registered issuers; provider = licensed firms; sandbox = sandbox participants; event = decisions/letters; candidate = full-text search hits, unconfirmed

offset.description: Number of entries to skip; the nextOffset of a previous answer continues from there

query.description: Free-text match on entry name, issuer, ISIN or register number

name: get_country_registers

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset to fetch the next page; absent when there is no more

title: Official country registers
